name: Father Christmas and the Cheeky Elf
speaker: media_player.sonos_move

soundtrack.title: Father Christmas and the Cheeky Elf

voice.name: Willoughby - Distinguished & Patient
voice.pitch_and_speed: Natural; no pitch shifting or time stretching

music.title: We Wish you a Merry Christmas

narration.text: Ho, ho, ho! Good evening, everyone. Father Christmas here, with a little magic for you.
Bushes, wake up! One by one. Lovely Christmas colours, all around the garden.
Windows, it's your turn! Each little pane, a Christmas jewel. Round we go, one at a time.
Christmas tree, show us your sparkle!
Icicles, a touch of winter magic.
Splendid! Christmas colours and rainbows, together.
Hang on! A cheeky elf has dashed inside. After him, Twinkly! Through the rooms and up the stairs!
He's nearly got away! Oh, you mischievous little fellow!
Oh dear. The Christmas sparkle has frozen!
Just a little snow in the works. A pinch of magic... there we are!
Right then. All together, count us in!
Five.
Four.
Three.
Two.
One!
Eclipse.
Up Down.
Bright Twinkle.
Vertical Flag.
Night Sky.
Christmas Spirit!
From all of us at the North Pole, have a wonderful Christmas. Good night, everyone. Ho, ho, ho!

sections.title: An elf indoors, Twinkly in pursuit
A little snow in the works
